criteria.GDN-030-AC01: Closed event schema binds opaque actor/subject references, reason, revision and request identity; no arbitrary private payload.
criteria.GDN-030-AC02: Bounded hash-chain and trusted-checkpoint verifiers detect changes, gaps, wrong scope and missing suffix relative to a trusted checkpoint. Owner-rewrite detection requires independently held anchors.
criteria.GDN-030-AC03: Runtime grants, immutable triggers and real PostgreSQL checks deny editor history modification; independent security review remains outstanding.

remaining: Operationally trusted checkpoint and restore procedures
